record.title: Orlivka–Isaccea ferry crossing suspended after attack, 26 September 2023
record.endpoint_type: reopening of passage; ordinary timetable normalization not established
record.scope: Orlivka–Isaccea international Danube river ferry checkpoint only
record.direction: Both directions at the named ferry checkpoint
record.movement: People and vehicle traffic using this ferry crossing; whole Romania–Ukraine frontier was not closed.
record.exceptions: Romanian notice permitted processing of inward vehicles already inside the checkpoint at suspension.
record.imposing_authority: Ukrainian border authorities; Romanian Coast Guard operated the corresponding Isaccea suspension
record.enforcement: Border crossing operations suspended; ferries anchored on the Romanian bank.
record.consequences: Traffic diverted to other crossing routes.
record.relationship: Separate September and October episodes; never combine across the September 26 reopening.
record.status_observation: Historical episode; evidence dates only. No inference about status at observation cutoff.
record.official_rationale: Border-operation suspension following the overnight attack on the Ukrainian checkpoint area. The inspected notices do not distinguish the share of downtime due to security assessment from damage clearance.
record.context: Overnight attack on the Ukrainian checkpoint preceded the official suspension.
record.uncertainty: Exact start hour is unestablished. The 18:20 operational restart in Romanian notice differs from the Ukrainian announcement time 18:40; these are different timestamps. The separate contribution of security precautions and physical clearance/repair is unresolved. Deliberate Russian intent to sever this international crossing is not independently verified.
